purpose: Determine whether a U.S. public filer has an SEC EDGAR filing matching the requested form within a caller-selected freshness window.

decisions.recent_filing: At least one matching filing has filingDate on or after the freshness cutoff.
decisions.no_recent_filing: The company resolved successfully, but no matching filing falls inside the requested freshness window.
decisions.company_not_found: The ticker/CIK did not resolve to an SEC submissions record.

claim_boundaries: freshness is based on SEC filingDate metadata only
the result does not interpret filing contents
the result is not an investment recommendation
no_recent_filing does not mean the company made no disclosures outside EDGAR or outside the requested form filter
